distribution.summary: 中国大陆（区域记录，未细化至省级）；台湾
distribution.narrative: Beaver & Liu (2010) accepts Taiwan occurrence and gives the broad distribution wording China (SE); Taiwan. The broad China (SE) wording is not expanded into province-level mainland records without additional province-level evidence.

host_note: The source reports seeds of broad-leaved trees, occurrence below bark, and Pteridium aquilinum fronds. These are broad ecological/host-context statements and are not converted into inferred host taxa in the current summary.
taxonomy_summary: The current accepted identity is Coccotrypes cardamomi Schaufuss, 1905.

taxonomic_history.name: Coccotrypes cardamomi
taxonomic_history.note: Current accepted name in the integrated taxonomic backbone.

nomenclature_note: The current accepted identity is Coccotrypes cardamomi Schaufuss, 1905, VSN_1154, Scolytinae: Dryocoetini. Beaver & Liu (2010) uses the same species name and authorship Schaufuss.
